readme:
HONORING THE PAST, FUNDING THE FUTURE. Core Principle: "Generational wealth deployed for generational change" Mission Statement Reflected in Design:.

**Blend:** Foundation 30% + Heritage Society 25% + Art Deco Luxury 20% + Light Academia 15% + Pearlcore 10%  
**Temperature:** 6/10 (warm) · **Formality:** 9/10 · **Tags:** premium, association  
**Perfect for:** Philanthropic Foundations, Legacy Donors, Charitable Trusts

## Content fundamentals

- Write for members and staff of the organization: direct, formal and composed.
- Headings name the thing plainly: “The Hamilton Foundation”, “Foundation at a Glance”, “Featured Grantees”, “Scholarship Endowment Program”.
- Buttons are short verb phrases in Title Case: “Contribute”, “Request Consultation”, “Download Prospectus”.
- Navigation uses single nouns: “Overview”, “Grantmaking”, “Endowment”, “Board”.
- The reference page uses emoji as inline glyphs (🏛 🎓 🎨 ⚕ ©); keep them functional, never decorative.

## Color

- Set the page on `page-bg` with body text in `page-text`. The theme is light.
- Identity colours: `pearl-cream`, `legacy-gold`, `bronze-metal`, `library-brown`. Lead with the first; use the rest for accents and emphasis.
- Each token's note says where the reference page uses it and, for text colours, its contrast on `page-bg`. Keep body text at 4.5:1 or better.

### Palette rationale

- --antique-cream: #faf9f7    → Aged elegance, timeless foundation
- --legacy-gold: #c9a227      → Endowment wealth, golden legacy
- --heritage-burgundy: #7c2d12 → Institutional tradition, donor trust
- --bronze-metal: #8b6914     → Award recognition, honor bestowed
- --marble-white: #f8f7f5     → Classical architecture, purity
- --library-brown: #59311f    → Leather volumes, scholarly depth
- --pearl-cream: #fefdfb      → Subtle luxury, refined finish
- --charcoal-gray: #2d2d2d    → Formal text, serious tone

## Typography

- `display` — Georgia, "Times New Roman", serif

- Set titles in `display`, sections in `heading-2` and running text in `body`.
- Uppercase is reserved for small labels (`label`), always with the letter-spacing given.

### Type rationale

- Serif headings: Classical authority, institutional gravitas
- Traditional hierarchy: Formal structure, clear precedence
- Generous spacing: Dignified breathing room
- Legacy numbers: Large donor recognition, endowment totals
- Fine print: Legal precision, fiduciary detail

## Spacing, shape and elevation

- Spacing steps: `space-xs` 8px, `space-sm` 16px, `space-md` 24px, `space-lg` 40px, `space-xl` 64px, `space-2xl` 96px. Pad cards and sections from these steps only.
- Corners: `radius-sm` 4px, `radius-md` 8px, `radius-lg` 12px, `radius-xl` 16px.
- Elevation: `shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`, `shadow-lg`, `shadow-xl`, lowest first for resting cards, higher for hover and overlays.

## States and motion

Timing values: `--transition-fast` 200ms ease, `--transition-base` 300ms ease, `--transition-slow` 500ms ease.

- Honour `prefers-reduced-motion`: drop lifts and transitions to instant state changes.

## Iconography

- Inline SVG line icons on a 24×24 viewBox, 2px stroke, drawn in `currentColor` so they take the text colour around them.
- No logo ships with this style: set the organization name in the `display` style.

## Accessibility

- `page-text` on `page-bg` measures 13.1:1.
- Every interactive element shows a visible focus state at 3:1 or better against its surface.

## Further guidance

### Primary (30%) - Foundation Institutional Principles

- Endowment stewardship: Long-term vision, generational impact
- Grantmaking excellence: Rigorous evaluation, strategic funding
- Philanthropic tradition: Legacy of giving, historic continuity
- Fiduciary responsibility: Financial prudence, accountability
- Donor relations: Respect for benefactors, naming recognition
- Board governance: Trustee leadership, committee structure
- Impact measurement: Evidence-based outcomes, ROI on social good

### Secondary (25%) - Heritage Society Aesthetics

- Timeless elegance: Classical proportions, enduring design
- Archival quality: Preservation mindset, lasting materials
- Ceremonial dignity: Formal occasions, respectful presentation
- Institutional memory: Historical continuity, tradition honored
- Prestige signaling: Quality craftsmanship, refined taste
- Membership exclusivity: Selective community, donor circles
- Cultural patronage: Arts support, civilizational contribution

### Tertiary (20%) - Art Deco Luxury

- Geometric precision: Symmetrical patterns, angular motifs
- Metallic accents: Gold leafing, bronze details, silver highlights
- Luxe materials: Marble textures, polished surfaces
- Streamlined glamour: 1920s optimism, modern elegance
- Sunburst motifs: Radiating hope, illumination metaphors
- High-contrast drama: Bold blacks, rich golds
- Architectural grandeur: Monumental scale, impressive presence

### Quaternary (15%) - Light Academia

- Scholarly refinement: Intellectual pursuit, knowledge cultivation
- Library aesthetics: Book-lined wisdom, leather-bound volumes
- Parchment tones: Aged paper, vintage documents
- Natural lighting: Soft daylight, reading-friendly illumination
- Classical education: Latin mottos, philosophical references
- Collegiate tradition: University heritage, academic excellence
- Thoughtful contemplation: Quiet spaces, reflective mood

### Quinary (10%) - Pearlcore Iridescence

- Subtle shimmer: Mother-of-pearl effects, soft luster
- Organic luxury: Natural gem quality, refined elegance
- Creamy opalescence: Soft white with hints of color
- Sophisticated femininity: Grace without frills
- Timeless beauty: Classic jewelry aesthetic
- Soft glow: Gentle radiance, understated glamour
- Premium materials: High-end finish, quality signaling

### Temperature

- (Balanced neutral-warm)

### Formality

- (Very high institutional dignity)

### Compatibility Matrix

- Foundation × Heritage Society: 98% SYNERGY
- Shared values: Tradition, permanence, institutional gravitas
- Mutual reinforcement: Philanthropic legacy meets social prestige
- Visual harmony: Both favor classical, timeless aesthetics
- Tension point: Modern grantmaking vs. stuffy exclusivity
- Resolution: Contemporary professionalism with classic refinement

- Foundation × Art Deco Luxury: 85% SYNERGY
- Shared values: Excellence, quality, aspirational impact
- Mutual reinforcement: Serious mission meets elegant presentation
- Visual harmony: Both appreciate geometric precision
- Tension point: Opulence vs. charitable prudence perception
- Resolution: Restrained luxury, investment in lasting quality

- Heritage Society × Art Deco: 90% SYNERGY
- Shared values: Timelessness, cultural significance
- Mutual reinforcement: Classic meets glamorous
- Visual harmony: Both favor symmetry, prestige
- Tension point: Victorian reserve vs. Jazz Age exuberance
- Resolution: Dignified elegance with measured richness

- Light Academia × All Foundation Blends: 88% SYNERGY
- Enhancement: Adds intellectual depth to philanthropic mission
- Challenge: Can feel too casual for high-formality contexts
- Resolution: Scholarly gravitas without collegiate youth
- Integration: Parchment tones, library references, wisdom motifs

- Pearlcore × All Blends: 75% SYNERGY
- Enhancement: Softens formality, adds refined femininity
- Challenge: Shimmer can conflict with serious institutional tone
- Resolution: Subtle iridescent accents, not dominant theme
- Integration: Pearl buttons, soft cream highlights, gentle glow
